topic: Demonstration and explanation procedure of removal and fitment of various LRUs/ major assemblies i.a.w ASM.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration and explanation procedure of removal and fitment of various LRUs/ major assemblies i.a.w ASM.
specific_objectives: 21.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to explain the procedure of removal and fitment of various LRUs i.a.w ASM

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of LRU removal and fitment procedures using IB and L & Ds; Safety precautions regarding static discharge and torque limits; Instructor supervision of trainee queries during explanation.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of an Assembly Manual (ASM)?
Why must removal and fitment procedures be followed strictly?
What are the potential consequences of incorrect LRU installation?

development.content:
Pre-flight inspection requirements
ASM chapter identification
Required tools and equipment
Static discharge precautions
Workshop environment standards

Step-by-step removal procedure
Marking and tagging protocols
Torque specifications and limits
Seal installation guidelines
Post-fitment verification checks

Documentation requirements
Discrepancy reporting
Tool return verification
Area cleanup standards
Sign-off procedures

summary_questions: Explain the critical safety step before removing an LRU.
How do you verify that a fitment meets torque specifications?
What information must be recorded in the maintenance log after fitment?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the removal and fitment procedure for a specific LRU covered in the ASM, referencing the relevant chapter number and key safety precautions, to be used in the next practical session on documentation.

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical on documentation based on following maintenance evolutions:- Part 4 U/S log of MOD form 700C for an equipment removal / fitment, Progressing routine inspections, out of phase operations / servicing due as per Part 6 D, E, F and re-forecasting, A defect observed in any system during flying or on ground, Any limitation and husbandry defects as in Part 2A& 2B with their entries clearing procedure in Part 4, Any defect cleared by DI/DR, Any defect cleared by robbing action, Any defect cleared by replacement of component and forecasting its life, Entries made for grounding / CTF / MTF, Acceptance of A/C and clearing in Part 4 by pilot for Ground run, CTF & MTF, Documentation linked to independent checks, supervisory checks and checks on special occasions.
